text.offer: Jonas D'Accor says, "The Duke's tax men bleed Jasper dry. Six of them won't be collecting anything any more - see to it. Then find Priestess Themala, of Jala. A rebellion needs songs more than swords, and she knows every song worth singing."
text.progress: The Duke's soldiers guard the flagpoles he holds. Luisane d'Ile, Berg's merchant, knows where to find Themala.
text.complete: Priestess Themala laughs and strums a chord. "Tell Jonas I'll write him a song the whole of Meridian will sing. Songs are hard to hang." (Your liege has more for you at 25 renown. Fight in the lieges' battles, claim flags, and take their daily war errands to earn it.)
